sources.title: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-4bit — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: This model is a 4-bit quantized version of the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, hosted on Modelers.cn for the Huawei Ascend AI ecosystem. It leverages Alibaba's Qwen3.5 architecture, specifically the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variant which balances a large 35B total parameter count with a highly efficient 3B active parameter path per token.
